cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I've warmed your side of the bed, love. You sounded frozen waiting for that taxi.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could have picked me up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I could. Here's another blanket. I remember waiting outside your office last Christmas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised. Could you warm my feet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come here, love. Both feet. I wouldn't leave any part of you waiting forty minutes.

mechanism: A grants progressively more physical comfort as a superior caregiver while measuring it against an old time B left A waiting.
confusable: D84 seeks surrender of resentment; D93 keeps resentment active underneath the current care.
comparison: Blankets and cold feet differ from a late birthday cake and candle song.
seedUse: Use D93-b taxi cold, prior office wait and request for feet warmth, keeping all comfort tied to B contribution.
